description: Resemble AI's distilled 350M Chatterbox Turbo: GPT2 T3 backbone, GPT2 BPE tokenizer, and a 2-step meanflow S3Gen decoder for fast English TTS and zero-shot voice cloning.

packages.description: Third-party GGUF conversion of ResembleAI/chatterbox-turbo, published by 'cstr' for the CrispASR project (MIT-relicensed); not published by ResembleAI or audio.cpp. Two loose GGUF files (T3 + S3Gen) live side by side in this package's directory, so point --model at the T3 file directly (chatterbox-turbo-t3-q8_0.gguf), not the containing folder, to avoid the ambiguous-directory-GGUF check.
